To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed an effective and efficient method to facilitate knowledge discovery and management from the massive speech documents of the mobile workforce.

we have successfully developed an algorithm for document clustering that considers the document structure, and the algorithm can effectively and efficiently cluster documents in massive document sets.

we propose a novel method for automated text categorisation, named structured cosine similarity that furnishes document summarization with a new way on modeling on document summarisation, considering the structure (i.e. the document summary) of the documents so to improve the performance (in terms of quality, stabiliity and efficiency) of document clustering.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of clustering massive speech documents, which are attained from the wireless enterprise oral sharing conducted by the mobile workforce.
the development of algorithms for automated knowledge management and knowledge discovery in speech document clustering.

the problem of document summarization, and we present a new way of measuring document similarity, named as structured cosine similarity, which considers the document structures and the document contents.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed structured cosine similarity is able to provide a new way of document summarization and clustering in terms of document structure.
the structured cosine similarity method is a promising method to be applied for document summarization, which can also be extended to other areas of text clustering.

the proposed method of structured cosine distance (SCD) and structured cosine similarity (SSS) is a new way of measuring distance or similarity between documents, which can improve the quality, stability and efficiency of document clustering, especially for the documents of no rich document features.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed method of structured cosine can be used to improve the performance in document clustering in general and audio-based knowledge management in particular.
the SCS algorithm is able to improve the performance in terms of quality of clustering, stability of clustering, and efficiency of clustering, as well as the performance of document summarization.
we have developed a novel method of document clustering based on document summarization and ontology-based structured cosine similarity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the structured cosine similarity is a promising way to model on document clustering in the context of document summarization, and the method can be applied in other domains as well.
the structured cosine similarity is a promising approach for document clustering, and that it can also serve as a new paradigm for document summarization.

the proposed method of structured cosine can be applied to any text document clustering problem, and it can be used as a complementary approach to the existing text-clustering methods.
